description: This file defines the CreatedAuditActionService class, which implements the IAuditActionService interface for handling 'created' audit actions related to bookings. It includes schema definitions, methods for data versioning, migration, display title and JSON formatting, and data requirements.

classes.name: CreatedAuditActionService
classes.description: A service class for handling 'created' audit actions, including data validation, versioning, migration, and display formatting.

methods.name: getVersionedData
methods.description: Returns versioned data based on input fields.

methods.name: parseStored
methods.description: Parses stored data to extract fields.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number from data.

methods.name: migrateToLatest
methods.description: Validates and migrates data to the latest schema version.

methods.name: getDataRequirements
methods.description: Returns data requirements, such as user UUIDs, based on stored data.

methods.name: getDisplayTitle
methods.description: Generates a display title for the audit action, including host name and seat info.

methods.name: getDisplayJson
methods.description: Formats stored data into a JSON object for display, including times and status.
